en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Atiyya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> did not wear a ring except for a little while, until he<sup>saww</sup> left it’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ali ibn ‘ Atiyyah who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah used the ring for a very little time and then he (the Messenger of Allah) abandoned it.’”
